title: Nutty Mexican Lentils Rajas Con Crema
description: A buttery and velvety Mexican dish featuring French lentils, caramelize, and a flexitarian-friendly approach, served in a tagine pot.
instructions: In a large tagine pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed and drained French lentils, roasted and chopped poblano peppers, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the lentils and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and shredded cheese until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the lentils hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
